page.content:
Policy that readers must be able to check material in reliable sources.

How Verifiability connects

  • Topic: Citation culture — The verifiability policy produced Wikipedia's visible citation-needed culture.
  • Topic: Reliable sources — Reliable sources are what verifiability asks editors to cite.

What is Verifiability?

Verifiability, not truth as personal knowledge, is the test. The [citation needed] tag is the vernacular of that rule.

Key threads lead to Citation culture and Reliable sources.
